title: Add the route-planning seam and its specification tests
summary: navigation/ gains region, grid, graph and planner modules for issue #20 task 3. CostGraph is the three-method interface a planner searches and other mission work builds against; GridGraph implements it over a CostGrid that rasterises a SurveyRegion inflated by a PlanMargin. PlanMargin carries R-05 clearance as three separate terms, one being R-03's GPS position error bound, supplied per plan rather than held as a constant. The algorithms are deliberately unimplemented: seven bodies raise NotImplementedError behind a stated required result, and 42 of the 86 navigation tests fail until they are written. No manifest is added, because pull request #45 moves manifest generation into CI and removes CURRENT_MANIFEST.
next: Implement the seven challenge bodies so the 42 failing navigation tests pass, and freeze #20's footprint radius, stop tolerance, cell size and GPS error bound. The recorded margin arithmetic shows a several-metre bound leaves no feasible region inside the agreed 6 x 4 m area, so that area or that bound has to change before the demonstration can run.
